title: Boettcher Concert Hall

services.name: Ticket
services.desc: We understand that cost can be a barrier for certain people to experience live music. To help make your Symphony more accessible we are pleased to offer lower cost tickets including discounts for children, students, teachers, military personnel, large groups, and more. Colorado Symphony ticket prices vary based on the concert series and venue, but tickets for most concerts in Boettcher Concert Hall start at $20 and can range up to $131 (plus fees and taxes). Ticket prices will increase based on demand as the concert date approaches, so by purchasing early you will get the best price and the best seat selection. The quickest and easiest way to save on ticket prices is to sign up for eNotes -

blurb: Boettcher Concert Hall was the first ‘in the round’ symphony hall in the US. Built in 1978 as home for the Denver Symphony Orchestra-now the Colorado Symphony-the hall is part of the Denver Performing Arts Complex (DPAC).
